verdict.rationale: Oneleet lists SOC 2 as a supported framework [29]. Adding a framework automatically adds its controls, which can carry evidence and review history [15]. It also ships Formal and Comprehensive policy templates with a draft, review and publish workflow [48][11][12]. The included pentest feeds directly into the audit [13]. However, nothing documents distinct Type I and Type II paths, the Trust Services Criteria mapping, or built-in evidence requests; the AI evidence collection shown is marketed under the separate Fieldwork offering [16]. Missing for 10: explicit Type I vs Type II audit workflow, documented Trust Services Criteria control library, built-in evidence request tracking, independent or hands-on corroboration.
